description: Every call of runTool( outside server/services/run/, with the reason it may skip the tool runner and the issue that removes it. server/tests/run/runToolCallers.test.js fails for a caller that is not listed and for an entry that no longer calls runTool.

entries.reason: Frozen legacy workflow executor: executeToolCall runs the tools of a legacy prompt node through its own agent loop (sha256 in workflow-legacy-frozen.test.js). Legacy workflow runs get none of the tool runner's guarantees in the first release.
Frozen legacy workflow executor: a legacy tool node runs the tool the workflow author chose, not one a model picked (sha256 in workflow-legacy-frozen.test.js).
